review_description: Gary came to sight and answered all questions.Quote & installation was seamless, prompt, neat and nothing too much trouble.

Gary and his team have been honest and more than helpful in every aspect of the journey of us first enquiring about solar to installation. An extremely professional outfit with local backup well into the future. We are extremely pleased with Solargain Warrnambool’s outstanding craftsmanship and recommend Gary if you are contemplating installing solar.

Gary and the team at Solargain in Warrnambool were easy to work with through the whole quote and installation. Gary gave good honest advice on the size of system I needed and didn't try to up sell anything.Installation was without any problems and was completed over 2 days.Very happy with the price, quality of components and performance of the system.I'm glad I could support a local installer and not one of the in & out companies from the big city.

Supplier helped me with my vic solar submission, explained how it works.Walked me through the installation, planned out the layout and consulted with me on options and final design.Neat and tidy installation, and explained the subsequent steps with inspection, meter configuration, etc.
Gary was very honest and informative. His price was great and his work was excellent
Gary has been very helpful and great do do business with, very knowledgeable.

We have been very happy from beginning to end with the whole process.  We got three quotes via your website and decided to go with Solargain.  Gary Opperman was highly professional and gave solid reasons behind the products which he recommended for our circumstances.  He was open to discussing alternatives and took the time to explain the pros and cons, and financial rationale (bang for buck) against warranty/quality for these.  His installation was very neat.  Gary was very responsive to our emails, texts and calls.   Highly recommended.
Hassle free experience.Turned up when he said he would.Did what he said he would.No hesitation in recommending Gary to anyone.

Not installed yet need meeter box replaced but all ordered and sitting ready to go The owner of solar gain Warrnambool never done a salesman sell just told me honestly what I needed to know and I also had a friend who has dealt with him and he gave me a very good report.

Gary Opperman was extremely efficient. Gary investigated the site made recommendations supplied the quote negotiated with my electrician and installed the system in immediately.  I highly recommend Gary and crew for professionalism and great communication skills.

I advised the installer that the top corner of 1 panel overhangs the ridge & I was concern that it would affect the  efficiency of the system. He advised me that in his & his colleague's opinion it has a negligible effect on the overall performance of my system and he is happy to remove the panel if I wanted him to. I decided to accept his professional opinion and left the panel as it is.Still waiting for the meter to be configurated after the installation was completed just over a week ago.

Was disappointed with the installer.  Extremely rude to his apprentice in front of us.   Had a go at my husband about a cupboard in the garage.  Moved our foxtel dish without telling us & didn't put it back which meant we then had to wait a week for foxtel to come out & fix it as he had broken some wires.  Also very unhappy that he put the panels in & then said that the foxtel dish will probably shade some of the panels & it won't work as well.   Why didn't he put the panels higher there was plenty of room  at the time so this definitely annoyed me the most.
I think I have said it all

We have absolutely no qualms about recommending Gary Opperman from Solargain Warrnambool as a man of knowledge and integrity in the field of solar installations.
